datasheet_identity.title: SS22 THRU SS220 Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier

extraction_notes: SS28 is a Schottky barrier rectifier. The datasheet states that the cathode line denotes the cathode end; forward current and voltage are interpreted in the anode-to-cathode direction.

The Fig. 3 forward curve is the typical SS28-SS210 grouped curve. The Fig. 4 reverse curves are the typical SS28-SS220 grouped curves, with separate Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 100 degC branches. Plotted points are extracted from visible vector curves only and are not synthesized by interpolation.

The electrical-characteristics table forward-voltage entry is a maximum at IF = 2.0 A, while Fig. 3 values are typical curve readings. The reverse-current entry is a maximum; the junction-capacitance entry is typical.
The Fig. 4 x-axis is retained as percent of rated peak reverse voltage, preserving the published reverse-bias semantics. Its published mA y-axis values are converted to A.
The supplied PDF publishes no reverse-recovery-time or breakdown-voltage/current specification for SS28, so those spec fields are null.
